verdicts.reason: A breaks the layout. The headline is oversized and runs into the HONEY ROSEMARY pill. The subtitle is detached and sits top-right, away from the headline it supports. The flavour pills are reordered and scattered in a ragged cluster. The legal text is crammed into the pink circle. The huge CTA competes with the headline. B keeps the original structure, reading order and grouping, but it is mostly a scaled-down copy. The yellow circle now sits behind the headline instead of being cropped into the corner. The pill labels and legal text are very small at this size, and there is a lot of empty space between the copy column and the CTA.
